name: Comoros
summary: Four horizontal stripes of yellow, white, red and blue with a green triangle at the hoist bearing a white crescent and four white stars. Each stripe and star stands for one of the islands.
origin: The Comoros has changed its flag several times since independence from France in 1975. The current design was adopted with the 2001 constitution, in force from January 2002, after a secession crisis on Anjouan.

colors.name: White
colors.meaning: Mayotte (Maore), claimed by the Comoros but administered by France.

symbols.name: Crescent and four stars
symbols.description: A white crescent with four white stars in the green triangle.
symbols.meaning: Islam, and the four islands of the archipelago.

history.label: Federal Islamic Republic
history.note: Green with a crescent and four stars.

facts: One stripe represents Mayotte, which voted to remain French and is now a French department.
Its flag has changed at least six times since 1975.
The Comoros is a member of the Arab League.
clues: Four stripes with a green hoist triangle holding a white crescent and four stars.
Each stripe stands for an island, including one it does not control.
Its flag has changed many times since 1975.
